text: 倍轻松(688793.SH)公告称，公司控股股东、实控人马学军收到证监会《行政处罚决定书》，因其涉嫌操纵证券市场，证监会决定没收违法所得1011.83万元，并处以罚款3035.48万元，合计罚没4047.31万元。其中马学军个人承担罚款1184.19万元。同时，马学军被采取5年证券市场禁入措施及5年证券市场禁止交易措施。同日公告，公司董事长、总经理马学军因个人原因辞去董事、董事长、总经理等全部职务，辞任后不再担任公司任何职务。董事会推举董事刘志华代行董事长、总经理及相关委员会委员职责。
text_en: Breo (688793.SH) announced that controlling shareholder and actual controller Ma Xuejun received the CSRC's Administrative Penalty Decision. For suspected manipulation of the securities market, the CSRC decided to confiscate illegal gains of 10.1183 million yuan and impose a fine of 30.3548 million yuan, totaling 40.4731 million yuan in confiscation and fines. Ma Xuejun personally bears 11.8419 million yuan of the fine. He was also subject to a five-year securities market ban and a five-year prohibition on securities market trading. In a same-day announcement, the company said Chairman and General Manager Ma Xuejun resigned from all positions including director, chairman and general manager for personal reasons, and will no longer hold any position in the company after resignation. The board elected director Liu Zhihua to perform the duties of chairman, general manager and member of relevant committees.
